name: Effervescence
description: Smash attacks release a [aqua]bubble[/aqua] which envelops you for [effect:seconds][dark-gray]4-8 seconds[/dark-gray][/effect], blocking damage while you rise 4 blocks per second with increased aerial mobility. The [aqua]bubble[/aqua] pops early if you sneak or it blocks 10♥️ damage.
